attempts.text:
**The window starts on a spine.** Column 0, `azoR`, is in every chromosome, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 4% of calls; the model names it in 98% of genomes with 0.08 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 21 to 80% of calls.

**The first forks are hesitant.** Column 2, ynbC, takes 1.03 bits and column 6, pdxI, 1.02 bits, both in a region of plasticity in 77 to 80% of calls. Column 7, an autotransporter outer membrane beta-barrel family, is the most hesitant of the window at 1.26 bits and the fewest named, 71%, in a region of plasticity in 73% of calls.

**Branches run beside the forks.** Columns 1 to 3 carry a branch of 3 persistent families, `hrpA` to `aldA`, in 13 to 14% of chromosomes. Columns 5 to 18 carry 14 families, `cybB` to `ydcL`, in 12 to 14%, and columns 58 to 66 carry 9, `sapB` to a TetR/AcrR family regulator, in 13 to 28%. Columns 36 to 40 and 48 to 56 carry phage families, [[phage tail and head assembly]], in 15 to 20%.

**The middle is a mosaic.** Columns 27 to 29, `ydcT` to `ydcV`, are variable, persistent families in 13 to 14% of chromosomes, [[ABC transport]]. The `paa` genes, columns 17 to 23, [[phenylacetic acid catabolism]], sit at 47 to 48%, and the `abg` genes, columns 42 to 45, [[p-aminobenzoyl-glutamate hydrolysis]], at 52 to 54%. The `psp` genes, columns 72 to 77, [[envelope stress response]], are persistent at 53 to 54%.

**The model reads the spine best.** Across the window it names 88% of genes at 0.63 bits; persistent calls are named 97% at 0.24 bits, shell 82% at 0.83 bits, cloud 14% at 4.26 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.94 against 0.28 bits, and names fewer genes, 81% against 95%. The window ends at column 79, puuB, in 41% of chromosomes.

label: azoR
facts:
WINDOW: the azoR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor azoR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,300 to 2,379 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying azoR once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.63 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 18,560 calls, named 97%, 0.24 bits; shell 23,790 calls, named 82%, 0.83 bits; cloud 690 calls, named 14%, 4.26 bits. Outside an RGP 20,046 calls, named 95%, 0.28 bits; inside an RGP 22,994 calls, named 81%, 0.94 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 75 fork, 4 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.94 against 0.28 bits) and names fewer genes (81% against 95%); 22,994 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 7 ("autotransporter outer membrane beta-bar…") 1.26 bits, RGP 73%; column 2 (ynbC) 1.03 bits, RGP 80%; column 6 (pdxI) 1.02 bits, RGP 77%. The 50 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.64 bits on average; the other 30 columns: named 89%, 0.61 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 21-80%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 4%. Genes: azoR. named 98%; 0.08 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 21-80%. named 71-94% (mean 87%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 7, named 71%, 1.26 bits.
